jobs.title: Coconut Development Board Recruitment 2026: 21 Fresher Posts (LDC, Field Officer, Steno, DEO)
jobs.summary: Coconut Development Board (Ministry of Agriculture) has notified direct recruitment; 21 posts are open to freshers: 13 LDC, 5 Field Officer, 2 Stenographer Grade II and 1 Data Entry Operator. 12th-pass and graduate candidates can apply online by 21 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: LDC 12th + typing 35/30 wpm; Field Officer 12th Science + Agri/Horti diploma; Steno Gr II and DEO graduate + skill test
Age: max 27 years (LDC, Field Officer, DEO), 30 years (Steno); relaxation as per rules
Pay: Level 2 (Rs 19,900) to Level 6 (Rs 35,400) starting basic
Fee: Rs 300; SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen/Women nil
Selection: written test / interview + skill test (as per notification)
Dates: apply within 30 days of Employment News (21-27 Nov 2026), last date 21 Dec 2026

jobs.title: Kerala High Court Civil Judge 2026: 21 Posts, No Practice Needed
jobs.summary: The High Court of Kerala has re-opened Civil Judge (Junior Division) recruitment for 21 posts (15 PwBD special recruitment, 3 NCA, 3 regular). Law graduates whose degree is at least one year old can apply by 16 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: law degree recognised by Bar Council of India, obtained at least 1 year before the notification; no minimum practice
Age: below 35 years as on 01-01-2026; SC/ST +5, OBC +3, PwBD +10
Fee: Rs 1,250; SC/ST/unemployed PwBD nil
Selection: preliminary (screening), main written exam (4 papers), viva-voce
Dates: apply 23 Nov - 16 Dec 2026; prelims 7 Feb 2027 (tentative)

jobs.title: RSSB Junior Engineer 2026: 1,909 Civil, Electrical and Mechanical Posts
jobs.summary: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board has raised JE vacancies under Advt 10/2026 from 874 to 1,909 in six departments, for B.E./B.Tech and diploma holders in Civil, Electrical and Mechanical/Electrical. Apply online by 17 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: degree or diploma in the relevant branch; Hindi (Devanagari) and knowledge of Rajasthani culture
Age: 18-40 years as on 01-01-2027; relaxation as per rules
Pay: Rajasthan Pay Matrix Level 10
Fee: OTR Rs 600 (General) / Rs 400 (Rajasthan reserved, PwD)
Selection: written exam, merit and department preference, document verification
Dates: apply 18 Nov - 17 Dec 2026; exam 3-5 Feb 2027 (proposed)

jobs.title: ECIL Apprentice 2026: 242 Graduate Engineer and Diploma Apprentice Seats
jobs.summary: ECIL Hyderabad (Advt 12/2026) is engaging 200 Graduate Engineer Apprentices and 42 Technician (Diploma) Apprentices for one year from January 2027. B.E./B.Tech and diploma holders who passed on or after 1 April 2024 can apply by 13 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: B.E./B.Tech or 3-year diploma in ECE, CSE/IT, Mechanical, EEE, EIE, Civil or Chemical, passed on or after 01-04-2024; NATS registration
Age: max 25 years as on 31-12-2026; SC/ST +5, OBC +3, PwD +10
Stipend: Rs 12,300 (GEA), Rs 10,900 (TA) per month
Selection: document verification 17-19 Dec 2026 and merit on degree/diploma marks
Dates: apply online by 13 Dec 2026
